subject: Astronomy & Space
title: The James Webb Space Telescope
description: A 60-second lesson on The James Webb Space Telescope.

hook.text: JWST is the most powerful space telescope ever built. It sees infrared light from the earliest galaxies in the universe.

buildup.text: Its gold-coated mirror is 6.5 meters wide, folded to fit inside a rocket. It unfolded perfectly in space.

discovery.text: Launched in December 2021, its first images revealed galaxies from just 300 million years after the Big Bang.

twist.text: JWST cost $10 billion and took 25 years to build. It was nearly canceled multiple times before launch.

climax.text: It orbits 1.5 million km from Earth at the L2 Lagrange point, shielded from the Sun by a tennis-court-sized sunshade.

punchline.text: Twenty-five years of patience. Now seeing the universe's first light.

quiz.question: Where does the James Webb Space Telescope orbit?
options: At the L2 Lagrange point, 1.5 million km from Earth
In low Earth orbit, alongside the ISS
Around the Moon in a polar orbit

details.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), launched December 25, 2021, is the most powerful space telescope ever built. Its 6.5-meter gold-coated mirror observes infrared light from the first galaxies, star-forming nebulae, and exoplanet atmospheres.
details.whyItMatters: JWST is already rewriting astronomical knowledge — discovering unexpectedly early galaxies, imaging exoplanet atmospheres in detail, and revealing star formation with unprecedented clarity. It represents a new golden age of astronomical discovery.
takeaways: JWST launched in 2021 with a 6.5-meter gold-coated mirror
It observes infrared light from the earliest galaxies to nearby worlds
It orbits at the L2 point, 1.5 million km from Earth

faq.question: How is JWST different from Hubble?
faq.answer: JWST's mirror is 6.5 meters versus Hubble's 2.4 meters, collecting about 7 times more light. JWST observes primarily in infrared (seeing through dust and catching redshifted early-universe light), while Hubble works in visible and ultraviolet.

faq.question: Can JWST be serviced like Hubble?
faq.answer: No. At 1.5 million kilometers away (versus Hubble's 550 km orbit), no crewed mission can reach it with current technology. JWST was designed for a 10-year minimum mission with enough fuel for 20+ years thanks to an exceptionally precise launch. If something breaks, it cannot be repaired.
